issue_title_zh: 油价飙升、科技股回调、国债收益率掉头：华尔街又是心神不宁的一天
lead_zh: 今天读美联社（AP）的收盘综述。这类“每日股市报道”句式高度模板化，学会一篇，以后读 Reuters、CNBC 都轻松很多。重点看：涨跌动词怎么换着用、长句里的让步与原因结构。

article.title: Rising oil prices, falling technology stocks and reversing bond yields keep Wall Street unsettled
article.author: Stan Choe
article.excerpt_note: 节选自原文第 1–3 段与第 11–17 段（原文约 600 词）。版权归 The Associated Press 所有，仅供个人学习，完整报道请看原文。
sections: NEW YORK (AP) — Some sharp reversals kept financial markets unsteady on Thursday, as oil prices rose and U.S. stock indexes finished mixed.

The S&P 500 fell 0.5% for a second straight loss after setting its all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 51 points, or 0.1%, and the Nasdaq composite fell 1.3% as technology stocks took particularly hard hits.

Stocks felt pressure from a 4.1% rise in the price for a barrel of Brent crude oil, the international standard, to $104.28. It’s been pinballing between $96 and nearly $110 over the last month on uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow the global energy industry to return to normal.
On Wall Street, the ease in Treasury yields helped the majority of U.S. stocks rise, including two out of every three in the S&P 500 index.
PepsiCo climbed 3.7% after the snack and drink company reported stronger profit and revenue for the latest quarter than analysts expected, thanks in part to strength outside of North America.
But drops for several influential technology stocks overshadowed such gains.

Nvidia, the chip company that’s ridden the tidal wave of demand created by artificial-intelligence technology, fell 2.9%. Because it’s the largest stock by value on Wall Street, it was the heaviest weight on the S&P 500 even though other stocks had larger losses.
That included drops for other AI-related stocks, including Broadcom’s 4.3% fall and Micron Technology’s 4.8% slide.

The losses came even though a bellwether for the chip industry, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., reported growth for September that suggested its revenue for the latest quarter was strong enough to top analysts’ expectations. TSMC’s stock that trades in the United States fell 3%.
AI stocks are under heavy pressure to report big growth to justify how high their stock prices have soared in recent years because of the AI frenzy.

notes.head: sharp reversal
notes.zh: 急剧反转、大逆转。reverse 的名词。sharp 在财经新闻里修饰变化 = “剧烈的、陡的”：a sharp drop 暴跌，a sharp rise 急涨。

notes.head: keep + 宾语 + 形容词
notes.zh: keep sb/sth adj. = 使……保持某种状态。主语是 reversals（事），宾语是 markets，unsteady 是宾补。比 “made markets unsteady” 多了“持续”的意味。

notes.head: finish mixed
notes.zh: 收盘涨跌互现。股市报道固定说法：finish/close higher 收涨，finish lower 收跌，finish mixed 有涨有跌。

notes.head: a second straight loss
notes.zh: 连续第二天下跌。straight 这里不是“直的”，而是“连续的”= consecutive。常见：for the third straight week 连续第三周。

notes.head: all-time high
notes.zh: 历史最高点（反义 all-time low）。set / hit an all-time high 创历史新高。也可说 a record high。

notes.head: take a hit
notes.zh: 遭受打击、受损。take a hard hit = 受重创。生活中也常用：My savings took a hit this month.（这个月我的存款缩水了。）

notes.head: 同位语
notes.zh: 逗号中间的 the international standard 是同位语，补充说明 Brent crude（布伦特原油）= 国际基准油价。新闻里大量用 “名词, 解释性名词短语,” 来省掉一个从句。

notes.head: pinball (v.)
notes.zh: pinball 本是“弹珠台”，这里活用为动词：像弹珠一样来回乱弹 → 价格剧烈来回波动。It’s been pinballing 是现在完成进行时，强调“过去一个月一直在”。

notes.anchor: on uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow the global energy industry to return to normal
notes.head: 长难句拆解
notes.zh: on + 名词 = 因为……（on fears/hopes/news of… 财经高频）。about 后面跟 when 引导的名词性从句；从句内部是 allow sth to do（让……得以做）。直译：因为不确定与伊朗的战争何时能让全球能源业恢复正常。

notes.head: ease / Treasury yields
notes.zh: ease 名词 = 缓和、回落（动词：yields eased）。Treasury yields 美国国债收益率；收益率回落通常利好股市。

notes.head: two out of every three
notes.zh: 每三只里就有两只。表示比例的地道说法：one in five / one out of every five people。

notes.anchor: stronger profit and revenue for the latest quarter than analysts expected
notes.head: 比较结构被拉长
notes.zh: stronger … than analysts expected：stronger 和 than 中间夹了 “profit and revenue for the latest quarter”，读的时候要把两头连起来。= beat analysts’ expectations 超出分析师预期。profit 利润，revenue 营收。

notes.head: thanks in part to
notes.zh: 部分得益于……。thanks to 本身就是“由于”（多用于好结果），插入 in part 让语气更严谨：不是全部原因，而是原因之一。

notes.head: overshadow
notes.zh: 使相形见绌、盖过。over + shadow：影子盖在上面。科技股的跌幅“盖过”了其他股票的涨幅，所以指数整体还是跌。

notes.anchor: that’s ridden the tidal wave of demand
notes.head: that’s = that has
notes.zh: 注意这里 ’s 是 has 不是 is！that has ridden（ride-rode-ridden）现在完成时。ride the wave 乘势而上，tidal wave 巨浪 → 乘着 AI 需求的巨浪一路高歌。

notes.head: by value
notes.zh: 按市值算最大（by market value / market cap）。由于指数按市值加权，英伟达跌得不算最多，却是拖累 S&P 500 最重的一只：the heaviest weight on…

notes.head: 名词化表达
notes.zh: 不写 “Micron fell 4.8%”，而写 Micron’s 4.8% slide：所有格 + 幅度 + 名词。动词变名词，信息更紧凑，是新闻英语典型写法。slide 下滑，同类词：drop, fall, decline, dip, slump。

notes.head: 长难句：主干 + 让步
notes.zh: 主干：The losses came（下跌出现了）。even though 引导让步：主语 a bellwether…, TSMC,（同位语）→ 谓语 reported growth → that suggested… 修饰 growth → (that) its revenue was strong enough to top… 是 suggested 的宾语从句。

notes.head: bellwether
notes.zh: 风向标、领头羊。原意是“脖子上挂铃铛的领头公羊”。a bellwether for the industry = 行业风向标。

notes.head: top expectations
notes.zh: top 作动词 = 超过。top / beat / exceed expectations 超预期；反义 miss expectations / fall short of expectations。

notes.anchor: under heavy pressure to report big growth to justify
notes.head: 两个不定式连用
notes.zh: be under pressure to do（被迫要做……）+ to justify（目的：为了证明……合理）。justify 的宾语是 how high their stock prices have soared（how + 形容词 引导宾语从句）。

notes.head: frenzy
notes.zh: 狂热、疯狂。the AI frenzy = AI 热潮（带一点“不理性”的意味）。近义：craze, mania, hype。

review_words.example: The market saw a sharp reversal after the Fed's announcement.
Investors remained unsteady ahead of the jobs report.
Gold hit an all-time high this week.

review_words.zh: v. 来回剧烈波动（本义：弹珠台）
review_words.example: Bitcoin has been pinballing between gains and losses all day.
Stocks fell on uncertainty about interest rates.
Weak guidance overshadowed the company's strong results.
Apple is one of the most influential stocks in the index.
FedEx is often seen as a bellwether for the global economy.
Can the company justify such a high valuation?
Chip stocks have soared since last year.
The IPO set off a buying frenzy.

patterns.zh: 某事使……一直处于某种状态
patterns.from: Some sharp reversals kept financial markets unsteady on Thursday.
patterns.model: The surprise rate hike kept investors nervous all week.
patterns.model_zh: 意外加息让投资者整整一周都提心吊胆。

patterns.pattern: A happened, thanks in part to B.
patterns.zh: A 发生了，部分得益于 B
patterns.from: PepsiCo climbed 3.7% … thanks in part to strength outside of North America.
patterns.model: My English improved a lot this year, thanks in part to reading the news every morning.
patterns.model_zh: 今年我的英语进步很大，部分要归功于每天早上读新闻。

patterns.pattern: The [结果] came even though [让步].
patterns.from: The losses came even though a bellwether for the chip industry … reported growth.
patterns.model: The sell-off came even though the company beat earnings expectations.
patterns.model_zh: 尽管公司财报超预期，抛售还是来了。

patterns.pattern: be under (heavy) pressure to do sth to justify sth
patterns.zh: 面临（巨大）压力要做……来证明……合理
patterns.from: AI stocks are under heavy pressure to report big growth to justify how high their stock prices have soared.
patterns.model: Startups are under pressure to show profits to justify their valuations.
patterns.model_zh: 创业公司面临压力，要拿出利润来证明估值合理。

podcast.title: How's the stock market doing, minus AI?
podcast.zh: 和今天文章同一个主题：AI 和科技股撑起了指数，剔除它们之后市场其实没那么好。另有一段讲国债收益率曲线（yield curve）。主持人 Kai Ryssdal 语速适中，适合精听。
